title: Duplicate orders after replay
steps: Freeze publication of the affected mart while keeping raw ingestion available.
Compare producer retry identifiers with the consumer idempotency ledger.
Replay only the rejected partition once the duplicate key strategy is confirmed.
Record the correction window and validate downstream reconciliation before reopening the SLA.
escalation: Escalate to the event producer owner if a retry policy changed in the last deployment.
risk: Double-counted revenue can affect finance and merchant KPIs.

title: Customer event schema drift
steps: Quarantine only the incompatible payloads and preserve the original event envelope.
Diff the incoming payload against the published contract and identify the first incompatible field.
Agree a versioning path with the producer before widening a schema or accepting a new field.
Backfill the quarantined events only after the consumer compatibility test passes.
escalation: Escalate to the product instrumentation owner before changing the taxonomy.
risk: Attribution and funnel metrics can silently diverge if unknown events are coerced.

title: Inventory snapshot key integrity
steps: Stop the affected snapshot from replacing the latest trusted inventory view.
Measure the null-key rate by upstream warehouse and source extract time.
Recover the latest complete source slice instead of filling identifiers by inference.
Reconcile available quantity against the prior trusted snapshot before publication.
escalation: Escalate to the warehouse feed owner if the extract is incomplete at source.
risk: Bad stock keys can create false stockout alerts and incorrect fulfillment plans.
